newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: World beer sales up 1.4 pct in 96 - Heineken.
newsitem.headline: World beer sales up 1.4 pct in 96 - Heineken.

text.p: Dutch brewer Heineken NV said on Friday that the world beer market increased by 1.4 percent in 1996.

The brewer, Europe's biggest, said that total sales of beer brewed under its supervision rose by 10 percent to 70.7 million hectolitres, while sales of the Heineken brand increased by 4.6 percent to 17.9 million hectolitres.
The company said its Amstel brand did well to maintain its sales volume of 6.9 million hectolitres in a declining segment market, while Murphy's showed significant growth.
Heineken said its exports were a "particularly positive feature", growing by 10 percent in 1996.
Beer consumption was down in most European countries, depressed by moderate weather and weaker economies, but these lower sales were offset by gains in sales volumes in America and Asia.
